SELECT P.PRB_ID AS prbId, P.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, P.TITLE AS title, P.PRIORITY AS priority, PC.CODE_NM AS priorityNm, P.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, P.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, TO_CHAR(P.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_PROBLEM P LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON P.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'PROBLEM_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = P.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE PC ON PC.CODE_GRP = 'PRIORITY' AND PC.CODE_ID = P.PRIORITY WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY P.PRB_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_PROBLEM P WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT P.PRB_ID AS prbId, P.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, P.TITLE AS title, P.CONTENT AS content, P.PRIORITY AS priority, PC.CODE_NM AS priorityNm, P.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, P.ROOT_CAUSE AS rootCause, P.SOLUTION AS solution, P.REG_ID AS regId, TO_CHAR(P.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt, P.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, TO_CHAR(P.RESOLVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS resolveDt FROM OPS_PROBLEM P LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON P.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'PROBLEM_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = P.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE PC ON PC.CODE_GRP = 'PRIORITY' AND PC.CODE_ID = P.PRIORITY WHERE P.PRB_ID = #{prbId}

SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId, H.PRB_ID AS prbId, H.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, H.CONTENT AS content, H.PROC_ID AS procId, TO_CHAR(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt FROM OPS_PROBLEM_HIS H LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'PROBLEM_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = H.STATUS WHERE H.PRB_ID = #{prbId} ORDER BY H.HIS_ID

SELECT I.INC_ID AS "incId", I.TITLE AS "title", SC.CODE_NM AS "statusNm" FROM OPS_PROBLEM_INC PI JOIN OPS_INCIDENT I ON PI.INC_ID = I.INC_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INCIDENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS WHERE PI.PRB_ID = #{prbId} ORDER BY I.INC_ID

SELECT K.KEDB_ID AS kedbId, K.PRB_ID AS prbId, K.TITLE AS title, K.SYMPTOM AS symptom, K.CAUSE AS cause, K.WORKAROUND AS workaround, K.SOLUTION AS solution, TO_CHAR(K.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_KEDB K WHERE K.PRB_ID = #{prbId} ORDER BY K.KEDB_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_KEDB WHERE PRB_ID = #{prbId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_PROBLEM (SYS_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, PRIORITY, STATUS, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO OPS_PROBLEM_HIS (PRB_ID, STATUS, CONTENT, PROC_ID, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{prbId}, #{status}, #{content}, #{procId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO OPS_KEDB (PRB_ID, TITLE, SYMPTOM, CAUSE, WORKAROUND, SOLUTION, REG_DT) VALUES (#{prbId}, #{title}, #{symptom}, #{cause}, #{workaround}, #{solution}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
